summary: First-finish smoke testing of Amsale Café app. Backend (5 endpoints) and Frontend (hero, navbar+drawer, cookie banner, menu tabs, gallery, reviews, visit, contact form submission, footer legal modals) all functional with 0 console errors.
passed: POST /api/contact invalid email -> 422 with EmailStr validation error
POST /api/contact with honeypot -> 200 but NOT persisted in GET /api/contact (verified by absence of BotUser_HoneypotMark)
Frontend root URL loads with no console errors
Hero renders 'Amsale Café' title; hero-cta-menu and hero-cta-visit testids present
Navbar visible with nav-call-button; clicking nav-hamburger opens nav-drawer.open
Menu section: all 4 tabs (espresso/food/cold/seasonal) present and switchable
Visit section: iframe map + visit-directions-btn present
Contact form submission: filled name+email, clicked contact-submit, contact-success appeared (frontend->backend POST integration confirmed)
Cookie banner shown on first load, accepting hides it and persists 'accepted' in localStorage (key: amsale_cookie_consent)
Footer footer-privacy opens legal-modal-privacy; ESC closes the modal
Zero console errors on page load and during interactions
notes: Did not exhaustively test footer-terms / footer-accessibility modals or anchor-link smooth scrolling navigation from drawer, or gallery image click overlay/gallery-close — core flows verified. Pre-existing shadcn lint errors in calendar.jsx/command.jsx ignored per instructions.
